verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official MCP server (server-card.json exposing tools like read-only SQL query execution, pipeline/secrets/schema inspection) and a dedicated dlt-mcp GitHub repo, plus dltHub AI Harness docs describing MCP servers that teach coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build and manage pipelines. This is first-party, documented, and named for specific agent clients. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice, and more detail on setup/connection steps beyond the server-card and harness docs.
